item.title: WRE News: Miami-Fort Lauderdale Rents Drop Again, Extending 29-Month Decline
item.description: Miami, FL - March 2, 2026 - The latest report from Realtor.com shows January 2026 marked the 29th consecutive month of year-over-year rent decreases for 0–2 bedroom units nationwide, with Miami-Fort Lauderdale-West Palm Beach following suit. In South Florida, the median asking rent dropped to $2,236 — a 3.7% annual decline — as vacancy rates fell slightly to 8.1% in 2025 but remained well above the 7% threshold that signals a renter-friendly market. item.title: WRE News: Team Behind Yamashiro Bringing Vintage-Inspired “400 Club” Vinyl Lounge to Miami
item.description: Miami, FL - March 5, 2026 - A new vinyl-driven lounge inspired by old Hollywood glamour and Japanese listening bars is set to debut in downtown Miami. From the team behind Yamashiro Miami, the intimate 400 Vinyl Room will open next door on the ninth floor of Gale Miami Hotel & Residences, introducing a concept rooted in music, nostalgia, and elevated nightlife.
